Creates or fixes scheduler jobs so the maintenance bundle runs on schedule:
retention_tolerance,

audit_event_aggregation, maintenance WAL trigger, hourly object-count-report,
hourly improvement-report,

cache_prewarm (SCH-007), autofix_batch_cleanup, autofix_run, and
autofix_process_pending. Lists jobs via CLI, then creates from

scripts/scheduler_jobs/ templates (or updates job_type) if missing or wrong.

See docs/observability/RETENTION_TARGET_VISIBILITY_GAP.md and
PARTIAL_IMPLEMENTATION_GAPS.md.

  Ensure jobs exist or fix job_type
  zqk system ensure-retention-jobs
  JSON output
  zqk system ensure-retention-jobs --format json

Usage:
  zqk system ensure-retention-jobs [flags]

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
